literal: Intellect, appearance, deeply studied learning—he who has the fullness of these three, let him go for the mission.
translation: Let him who possesses the perfect combination of these three qualities—natural intellect, a dignified appearance, and deeply studied learning—go forth on an envoy's mission.
modern: இயற்கை அறிவு, தோற்றப் பொலிவு, ஆராய்ந்து கற்ற கல்வி ஆகிய இம்மூன்றின் செறிவை உடையவன் தூதுச் செயலுக்குச் செல்லட்டும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the three essential personal qualities required for an envoy before they are sent on a diplomatic mission. First is natural intellect (அறிவு), which allows them to think critically and respond wisely. Second is a dignified or pleasing appearance (உரு), which commands immediate respect and creates a favorable impression. Third is deeply studied learning (கல்வி), ensuring they are well-versed in statecraft and history. One who possesses the fullness (செறிவு) of these three attributes is the ideal candidate to represent a state.
